QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] On the Move Again
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've all had a good night's sleep, the caravan is ready to continue the journey. Just as you're ready to depart, Kan hurries up to tell you that Slaka's disappeared, along with some food. The snowstorm is only getting closer, and the group is low on food. The situation is starting to look a little grim.
